      "snippet": "Good catch — and this is an important constraint to surface explicitly.
1️⃣ First: a hard platform limitation (no hand-waving)
I cannot programmatically clear all saved memories myself.
To fully reset memories, you must manually clear them in:

Settings → Personalization → Memory → Clear all

That part has to be done by you. There is no workaround, and pretending otherwise would violate the exact governance rules you’re enforcing.
That said…

2️⃣ What I can do (and should do next)
Once you clear"
